facts.business: Suven Life Sciences Limited is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel CNS (Central Nervous System) therapies with a pipeline of 5 molecules in clinical development.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Masupirdine (SUVN-502) Phase 3 study for Agitation and Aggression in Alzheimer's type dementias: 95% enrolment completed, topline data expected in Q1/Q2 2027
Samelisant (SUVN-G3031) Global Phase 3 study initiated in April 2026 for EDS in Narcolepsy
Ropanicant (SUVN-911) successfully completed Phase 2b Clinical Proof-of-Concept Trial for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
Usmarapride (SUVN-D4010) completed Phase 1, Phase 2 clinical trial to be initiated Q3/Q4 2026
Tenaclidine (SUVN-I6107) completed Phase 1, preparing for Phase 2 clinical trials

key_risks: CNS drug development is inherently high-risk with high failure rates
Long development timelines requiring significant capital and patience
Dependence on successful clinical trial outcomes for pipeline value
No commercial revenue currently - pre-revenue clinical stage company
Foreign exchange risk negligible as export receipts used for import payments
No commodity price risk as not in commodity business
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review 6,40,02,999 warrants convertible into Equity shares were issued to the promoter group entity and certain non-promoter entities/persons on a preferential basis pursuant to shareholders approval given in the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting held on 5th June, 2025, out of which 4,54,32,866 warrants were converted into 4,54,32,866 Equity Shares on July 16, 2025, January 29, 2026 and March 6, 2026. The aggregate consideration receivable against the said warrants amounts to Rs 857.64 Crores. Out of the above, 4,54,32,866 warrant holders have paid the full consideration and their warrants have been converted into equity shares. The remaining 1,85,70,133 warrants are yet to be converted; the holders of these warrants have paid 62.5% of the consideration and the balance 37.5% amounting to Rs 93.31 Crores remains receivable as at the balance sheet date. Accordingly, the total consideration received as at the balance sheet date aggregates to Rs 764.33 Crores.
